record.field: -- This query order tables by rows count SELECT sOBJ.name AS 'name', SUM(sPTN.Rows) AS row_count FROM sys.objects AS sOBJ INNER JOIN sys.partitions AS sPTN ON sOBJ.object_id = sPTN.object_id WHERE sOBJ.type = 'U' AND sOBJ.is_ms_shipped = 0x0 AND index_id < 2 -- 0:Heap, 1:Clustered GROUP BY sOBJ.schema_id, sOBJ.name ORDER BY row_count desc
-- This query order tables by rows count SELECT tbl, stat FROM sqlite_stat1
-- This query order tables by rows count SELECT relname AS name, n_live_tup AS row_count FROM pg_stat_user_tables ORDER BY row_count DESC;
